checkpoint_review: I agree with the Router's assessment on most checkpoints. The 'Eyes' checkpoint is correctly marked as missing due to the unnatural teal iris color, which contradicts the biological 'golden' requirement. The 'Coloration' checkpoint is also correctly marked as missing; while the iguana is green, it lacks the specific 'broad black bands' described in the taxonomy for adults, appearing instead as a uniform or banded green that doesn't match the specific textual description of adult coloration transitions. The 'Limbs' checkpoint is correctly marked as missing/untestable for digit counting due to occlusion and blur, though the Router noted structural plausibility which I will downgrade based on expert pose evidence. The 'Tail' checkpoint is correctly marked as untestable.
artifact_review: The Router identified three artifacts: texture anomaly (eye), structural collapse (foot), and perspective distortion (background). I agree with the eye artifact (severity 3) as the teal color is a definitive AI tell. I agree with the foot artifact (severity 2); the toes do appear fused/melted into the branch. The Router underestimated the severity of the limb issues by calling them 'plausible' in the checkpoint reasoning while flagging them as artifacts later. The animal_pose_auditor confirms HIGH risk with 65% low-confidence keypoints across limbs and face, supporting the visual observation of melting/fusion in the feet and potential structural ambiguity in the head/neck connection. The background distortion is minor (severity 1) and acceptable. No new major artifacts were found by experts, but the pose auditor strongly reinforces the limb fusion issue.
alignment_reasoning: 5 out of 8 checkpoints passed. Two critical biological features (eye color, specific banding pattern) are missing. One anatomical feature (digits) is untestable/missing due to generation quality. One structural feature (tail) is untestable due to framing. The high alignment score is penalized because the missing features are key taxonomic identifiers (iris color, banding) rather than minor details. The formula base was 2.95; I adjusted slightly down to 2.85 to reflect that the 'missing' items are significant biological deviations, not just occlusions.
artifact_reasoning: Router identified eye color anomaly (sev 3), foot melting (sev 2), and background distortion (sev 1). Expert pose auditor confirms HIGH artifact risk (65% low confidence keypoints), validating the foot melting and suggesting broader structural uncertainty in limbs/face. Topology auditor shows clean mask (0.98), ruling out severe boundary fragmentation, but this does not negate internal fusion. Perceptual auditor found no noise/blur, confirming the issues are generative/structural, not compression artifacts. Final score reflects the combination of a glaring color hallucination and confirmed structural fusion in the limbs.
key_defects: Unnatural teal/cyan iris color instead of biological golden/orange
Fused/melted front foot digits lacking distinct claw separation
Missing broad black bands on body/tail characteristic of adult common iguanas
High pose estimation uncertainty (65% low confidence) indicating widespread structural ambiguity in limbs
